categories.name: Ads & Trackers
categories.note: Blocks ad, tracking and analytics domains (HaGeZi Pro tier) - the core protection, leave it on. If a page misbehaves, allowlist that one domain rather than switching the category off.

categories.name: Malware & Phishing
categories.note: Blocks known malware, phishing and scam domains. Very low false-positive risk and no day-to-day breakage, so it is recommended on for every device on the network.

categories.name: Adult Content
categories.note: Blocks adult content domains. OFF by default. Coverage is partial - any device that ignores this resolver or uses encrypted DNS walks straight past it, so do not rely on it alone.

categories.name: Smart-TV ACR & Ads
categories.note: Blocks screen-content tracking (ACR) and TV ads. Samsung, LG and Vizio honour your DNS, so it bites there. Roku often hardcodes its own, so that share needs a router port-53/853 redirect.

categories.name: Amazon Device Telemetry
categories.note: Blocks Fire TV ads and Echo background telemetry. Voice commands still go to Amazon - this only stops silent usage reporting. Setup, auth and OTA hosts stay allowlisted so devices keep working.

categories.name: IoT Device Telemetry
categories.note: Mutes phone-home telemetry from Xiaomi, Huawei, Vivo and OPPO/Realme gear. Some cheap cameras retry hard when blocked and get noisy on the network; switch those devices to frictionless mode.

categories.name: Apple Telemetry & Ads
categories.note: Blocks Apple OS analytics and App Store ads. OFF by default and mostly placebo unless iCloud Private Relay and 'Limit IP Address Tracking' are off - Apple otherwise routes DNS around you.

categories.name: Windows/Office Telemetry
categories.note: Blocks Windows and Office diagnostic telemetry. OFF by default: Microsoft retries hard and some builds fall back to hardcoded IPs, so coverage is partial. Check Office sync and Xbox Live first.
